title: A roadside shrine, offerings uncounted
description: A weathered saint with the face worn off, a bowl of coppers at her feet, and dried flowers older than the war. Travellers still leave things here. Nobody is watching.

choices.text: Kneel a while. Let the wounded rest in the shade.

onPass.narration: Nothing answers, but the shade is cool and the water in the basin is clean. The company leaves lighter than it came.

choices.text: Leave a coin of your own.

onPass.narration: A copper joins the coppers. On the road out, a hare freezes in the grass and lets you pass. You decide that counts.

onFail.narration: You have nothing to leave. The saint does not seem to mind.

onPass.narration: Thirty-odd coppers, and every one of them feels heavier than it should. The company does not talk for a mile.
